experiments.title: Glass-box model (Explainable Boosting Machine)
experiments.hypothesis: A fully transparent additive model can match the black-box gradient boosting.
experiments.method: Same features, EBM with 5 pairwise interactions and 4 outer bags; test period metrics.
experiments.reason: As accurate as LightGBM while every prediction is an exact sum of readable contributions.

experiments.title: Uncertainty from model disagreement
experiments.hypothesis: Where the glass box and the black box disagree, a human should look.
experiments.method: |p(EBM) - p(LightGBM)| above the 95th percentile of out-of-sample disagreement on the last 4 training weeks.
experiments.reason: Flagged declarations are never released green; they go to a document check.

experiments.title: Anomaly detection (Isolation Forest)
experiments.hypothesis: Unusual declarations (value per kg far from the product's usual value, odd mass or volume) are more often fraudulent.
experiments.method: IsolationForest(300 trees) on unit-value z-score vs the product median, log mass, log value, tax rate and product/seller/declarant volumes, fitted on TRAIN.
experiments.reason: No signal: the top 1% anomalies are fraudulent at about the base rate.

experiments.title: 2-hop network features
experiments.hypothesis: An importer using sellers or declarants that serve fraudulent importers is riskier.
experiments.method: Out-of-fold smoothed fraud rate of the OTHER importers sharing the seller / declarant, added to LightGBM.
experiments.reason: No gain. CTGAN synthesises rows independently, so cross-row links are artefacts; re-test on real Tunisian data.
